title: The Fenced Goods
subtitle: hideUntilDependenciesComplete
description: `hideUntilDependenciesComplete` hides the node until its prerequisite *rule* is satisfied — the same rule the card's '2 of 3 met' counts, so `minRequired` and the started-based modes are honoured. A completed quest is always visible.
The difference from `invisible` is the trigger: this one appears the moment its dependencies open it, rather than waiting to be completed or stumbled upon.
